verdict.rationale: The public homepage offers a "Check Entity Status" link and a "Validate a Certificate" link, and the filing portal lets users search for a business by name. This shows the status of an existing entity, not of a pending filing or application. Official status confirmation otherwise means ordering a paid Certificate of Status, returned by mail. Missing for 10: public tracking of a submitted filing or name-reservation application, real-time processing or case status, and documentation or hands-on evidence of what the entity-status lookup actually shows.
